Hyderabad Man Booked Under POCSO for Alleged Daughter Harassment

A man in Hyderabad has been booked under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. He is accused of allegedly sexually harassing his daughter. The case has been registered by the police.
